title: DECODING MORAL JUDGEMENT FROM TEXT: A PILOT STUDY
reasoning: The paper investigates the feasibility of decoding 'moral judgement' and 'moral emotion' using passive brain-computer interfaces (EEG) in response to text stimuli. It specifically addresses how these neural correlates could be used to improve the human-compatibility and moral alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) through feedback mechanisms like RLHF.
